wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A carries NO transaction: the whole ruled grid is empty at 200 dpi and the filer wrote a single hand-written 'N/A' across the Mailing Address column near the top - a nil MARK, not a numeral and not a row, so zero rows are emitted and nothing is recorded as a zero-valued transaction. The printed TOTAL cell was left blank. Cover line 1 carries a written zero glyph in ALL THREE columns (0 under the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling), so the zero row set equals both the THIS and the CUMULATIVE cell; LAST is also 0, first report of the cycle, scopes coincide - recorded cumulative. Cover line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) is likewise 0 in all three columns, so there is no unitemized small-donor residue: this candidate raised nothing at all.

expenditures.detail: One inked row, 571.00, equal to Form B's printed TOTAL (571.00) and to cover line 3 THIS (571.00) and CUMULATIVE (571.00). Line 3 LAST is a written zero, so this is the first report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide - recorded cumulative. Both cover cells write the cents as a superscript 'oo' over the rule ('571.' + superscript) and are transcribed with the decimal point per the currency rule.

gates.page_subtotal: p3 rows sum 571.00 = printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES 571.00 (exact; the footer re-read in a 600 dpi crop and the row amount in a 1200 dpi cell crop, both reading 571.00). p2 has no gate to fire: the filer inked no rows and left the printed TOTAL cell blank, consistent with the cover's zeros.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3: 33 bands, status 'gaps' (some rules dropped), so treated as evidence not oracle; ink counted by eye on the 200 dpi page = exactly 1 written row, on the first data line. p2 at 200 dpi: every data band empty, no ink other than the 'N/A' mark in the Mailing Address column. ⚠ A long hand-drawn S-CURVE runs down the whole Amount column of p3 beneath the single row - a filer's strike-through voiding the unused lines. It carries no digits and is NOT a value or a row; it is recorded here and not transcribed. 1 row emitted on the expenditure side, 0 on the contribution side.
gates.geometry_proof: p3: crop pct:70.66,13.60,16.00,2.00 renders '$ 571.00' (the row-1 amount, complete); a control one row-pitch below (y 15.60%) renders an empty ruled cell carrying only the printed '$'. Passes. No contribution geometry is claimed - zero rows.
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 reads 0 LAST, (571.00) THIS, (571.00) CUMULATIVE - written in accounting PARENTHESES, i.e. negative. Chain closes exactly: contributions 0 minus expenditures 571.00 = -571.00, the bracketed figure. The candidate paid the filing fee out of pocket and carried the deficit rather than reporting a self-contribution.

escalation_note: 400 dpi crops of the cover money grid (lines 1-3 and lines 3-4, to separate written zeros from blanks and read the parenthesised negatives and superscript cents); 600 dpi crop of the p3 row-1 band and of the printed TOTAL footer; a 1200 dpi crop of the row-1 amount cell (to settle the cramped decimal point); and two geometry-proof/control pairs, the box widened once after the first pass clipped the final cents digit.
